calls.title: GrowthBook Tracking Experiment Training Session
calls.summary: The discussion centered on prioritizing full traffic exposure for quicker test results, with a prevalent method of 100% traffic and 50/50 split tests, as emphasized by Stacy Siso1. Luke Sonnet highlighted the efficiency of running tests at full traffic while addressing the intricacies of variation weight changes and their potential impacts. The meeting underscored the significance of implementing sticky bucketing to reduce data noise, enabling consistent user assignment amid traffic changes. Additionally, the conversation touched on the effective use of namespaces for managing parallel experiments and emphasized the tailoring of conversion windows for different experimental needs. GrowthBook's commitment to improving raw user-level data export capabilities for better analysis was also noted, supporting the ongoing refinement of experimentation strategies across teams.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Traffic Allocation, Conversion Windows, Sticky Bucketing, Metric Precision, Namespace Management
